netbox_irm_raw.dataset_description: NetBox is an open-source infrastructure resource modeling (IRM) and IP address management (IPAM) platform.

user.field_description: The NetBox user who made the change.

comments.field_description: The free-text content of the NetBox journal entry written by the user.

kind.field_description: The kind of the NetBox journal entry.

assigned_object.field_description: The NetBox object the journal entry is attached to.

assigned_object_type.field_description: The content type of the attached NetBox object, in app_label.model format.

request_id.field_description: The ID of the NetBox request in which the object change was made, in UUID format.

display.field_description: The human-readable label of the NetBox record.

action.field_description: The type of change made to the NetBox object.

changed_object_id.field_description: The ID of the NetBox object that the change was made to.

changed_object.field_description: The NetBox object that was changed.

changed_object_type.field_description: The content type of the NetBox object that was changed, in app_label.model format.

prechange_data.field_description: The attributes of the NetBox object before the change.

user_name.field_description: The username of the account that made the change to the object.
